import csv, io

def parse(text: str) -> list[list[str]]:
    reader = csv.reader(io.StringIO(text))
    return [row for row in reader if row]

print("test1:", parse("a,b,c"))
print("test2:", parse("a,b\nc,d\n"))
print("test3:", parse("a,b\n\nc,d"))
print("test4:", parse("a,,c"))
print("test5:", parse("a,b\r\nc,d\r\n"))
text = "\"Smith, John\",42\n\"multi\nline\",\"say \"\"hi\"\"\"\n"
print("test6:", parse(text))

from decimal import Decimal, ROUND_HALF_UP
q = Decimal(1).scaleb(0)
print("2.5 ->", Decimal("2.5").quantize(q, rounding=ROUND_HALF_UP))
print("-2.5 ->", Decimal("-2.5").quantize(q, rounding=ROUND_HALF_UP))

from decimal import Decimal, ROUND_HALF_EVEN, ROUND_HALF_UP

for rounding in [ROUND_HALF_EVEN, ROUND_HALF_UP]:
    print(rounding)
    print("2.4 ->", Decimal("2.4").quantize(Decimal("1"), rounding=rounding))
    print("2.6 ->", Decimal("2.6").quantize(Decimal("1"), rounding=rounding))
    print("2.5 ->", Decimal("2.5").quantize(Decimal("1"), rounding=rounding))
    print("3.5 ->", Decimal("3.5").quantize(Decimal("1"), rounding=rounding))
    print("0.125, 2 ->", Decimal("0.125").quantize(Decimal("0.01"), rounding=rounding))
